alternate_titles: Encyclical on Devotion of the Rosary
work.author: Pope Leo XIII
work.description: The encyclical of 1 September 1883, the first of Leo XIII's long series on the Rosary, consecrating the month of October to the Queen of the Rosary and commending the devotion against the evils of the age. The Latin original is in Acta Leonis XIII 3 (1884) 280-289. The Vatican English web text numbers paragraphs 2-11 after an unnumbered opening, the locus system used here.
work.title: Supremi apostolatus officio
